FuelledByFury.description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with all attacks for each time a friendly <style="Character">Character</style> has used an active ability this battle. The first time each turn that <style="Faction_Ultramarines">Titus</style> is defeated he cannot be <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. The first time each turn he defeats an enemy with an attack triggered by <style="FinalJustice">Final Vengeance</style> he is immediately revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.
